title: Ignite Cultural Fest 2027
resources: Sponsor-provided prizes, registration desk and photography team

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 324 attendees for this Cultural Fest, in line with turnout at our previous Cultural Fest events.
The requested budget of INR 78,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Cultural Fest.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
